admission.justification: The target contract, independent default resolution and pre-write validation together ensure every admitted realization keeps an authored explanation and valid role without partial converted writes; no member establishes the complete authoring boundary.

guarantee: Every realization target the converted file writer admits carries its author's nonblank explanation and a role from the stated target or explicit entry default; role absence is unclassified. The parser refuses malformed text, unknown roles, absent-literal routes and missing or overlong rationales before writes, naming the offending target. Stored historical claims are not retroactively reauthored; this guarantee asserts no database allocation-journal replay. In converted mode a malformed target refuses the whole hand-off and writes nothing; naming one offending entry does not admit sibling commits. The earlier per-entry sibling-commit clause is retained as legacy-mode provenance only while that path exists, not as a converted fallback.
